limitations: Short M3 history is not representative; empty validation/test intervals after embargo cannot establish out-of-sample performance.
Independent $5000 one-market simulations, not simultaneously funded multi-market portfolios.
MBP and aggregate trades cannot identify exact queues, hidden priority or individual counterparties. Results are modeled, never observed own fills.
No-trade benchmark is $5000 cash, zero exposure/fees. Inventory is acquired only through evidence-based modeled fills, never invented initial stock.
No account-eligible promotion or rebate has been verified. Hypothetical fees must not be presented as accessible tiers.
